messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-042 — Elevated 5xx / timeout rate for Dedicated EU pool node eu-ded-12. Trigger: error-rate > 3% for 3m. Paging @oncall-sre :rotating_light:

jessica.s: oncall-ack. I'm on it, grabbing logs + rota.

rick.m: thx. priority = P1 for any customer-facing degradation. @priya.k can you list enterprise customers on eu-ded-12?

priya.k: pulling mapping now. I have a quick list: Mistral Health (acct: mjensen@mistral.com), Solstice Bank (acct: ops@solstice.com), Arcadia Labs (cs@arcadia.ai). Mistral and Solstice are on dedicated pools, Arcadia uses private fallback.

alina.s: quick note — Mistral reported timeouts ~10:12 UTC in their ticket 5421. They saw chat session drop and retry spikes.

leo.t: logs show KV cache evictions + a CUDA out-of-memory retry loop on eu-ded-12 about 10:08-10:14. Suspect noisy tenant + batch sizing regression. Rolling pin to isolate noisy queue.

jessica.s: mitigation plan: 1) scale down batch window for eu-ded-12, 2) move Mistral and Solstice to eu-ded-15 (warm), 3) enable fallback routing to hosted fast-path if move fails. Rick, can you run the migration?

rick.m: starting migration for Mistral -> eu-ded-15 (canary 5% traffic) now. Will monitor 1min windows and pause on >1% errors. ETA ~8m.

incident-bot: migration-deploy started by rick.m at 1768245180. Canary 5% -> 50% -> 100% (auto).

priya.k: we need tailored comms. Drafting short status page + customer emails. For enterprise customers we should call key contacts after status page up. Priya will call Mistral (MJ), Solstice (Ops), and email Arcadia.

alina.s: draft status page blurb (please review):
```
We are investigating increased error rates for Dedicated EU capacity affecting a subset of enterprise customers. Impact: intermittent timeouts and degraded response times for inference requests. Mitigation: we are routing affected traffic to a healthy dedicated node and performing a controlled migration. Next update: in 15 minutes.
```

rick.m: edit suggest: add affected endpoints and customer impact lines. e.g., "Affected endpoints: POST /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Customer impact: chat/UI timeouts and occasional 5xx."

priya.k: customer-specific impact statements (suggested):
- Mistral Health: Users may see session drop and delayed chart generation; we recommend checking retry logic and extending client timeouts during migration. MJ prefers a phone update.
- Solstice Bank: Transactions not affected but model-driven autocomplete may be degraded for merchant search; Ops wants an SMS if degradation continues >30m.
- Arcadia Labs: low-impact (private fallback active). No action unless errors persist.

emily.c: FYI sales + CSM notified. @priya.k please paste phone numbers for the calls.

priya.k: phone: MJ (Mistral) +1-415-555-0198, Solstice Ops +44 20 7946 0991. Calling MJ now.

jessica.s: update: Mistral canary at 5% is holding, errors down to 0.6%. Proceeding to 50% in 2m.

incident-bot: migration-deploy progressed to 50% by rick.m at 1768245260.

leo.t: while migrating, applying temporary batch_size cap on eu-ded-12 to prevent reoccurrence. Also enabling KV cache hot key guard.

priya.k: MJ on call: thanks, they want a short email they can forward internally. Draft below — please thumbs up if ok:

```
Subject: Incident update — Mistral Health (Dedicated EU) — 10:12 UTC

Hi MJ,

We are investigating elevated error rates affecting Dedicated EU node eu-ded-12 which hosts your traffic. Impact: intermittent timeouts for inference calls and dropped chat sessions.

What we’re doing: routing a portion of traffic to a healthy node (eu-ded-15) and applying mitigations to prevent further errors.

Next steps: continuing migration; we will call back at the end of the migration with a summary.

Apologies for the disruption — we’ll follow up within 30 minutes.

- Redwood Inference Incident Team
```

alina.s: looks good. Adding ETA and contact lines: include SRE direct line + incident link.

jessica.s: migration at 100% now. Monitoring for 10m then mark resolved if stable.

incident-bot: migration-deploy completed by rick.m at 1768245320 -> traffic on eu-ded-15. Post-migration errors: 0.2% over 60s.

priya.k: called MJ and Ops; MJ acknowledged and will share with internal stakeholders. Solstice expects SMS if >30m — set reminder.

emily.c: sending runtime incident note to sales/CSM list.

rick.m: will keep watch for 30m, then update status page to resolved. If error creeps up we rollback.

jessica.s: marking incident state: mitigated. Next update in 30m or on escalation. Great work team :clap:

incident-bot: incident INC-2026-042 state=mitigated at 1768245340.
